activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1258, completion year of the Golestan after Saadi's return to Shiraz, as his representative literary milestone. His immediate patron was Salghurid Atabeg Abu Bakr; the existing Ilkhanate polity is used as the broader Mongol-era political context rather than creating a new polity solely to host a literary activity.

sources.title: GOLESTĀN-E SAʿDI — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica dates completion of Saadi's Golestan to 656/1258 and records its dedication to the Salghurid Atabeg of Fars, Abu Bakr b. Sa'd, his son, and the vizier.
